title: The wrong door
goals: Reach the foot of the long stairs.
starting_code:
# My program chooses the wrong door! Find and fix it so we go through the open one.
if left_door.locked:
    wizard.move_left(2)
    left_door.open()
    wizard.move_down(2)
    wizard.move_right(6)
else:
    wizard.move_right(2)
    right_door.open()
    wizard.move_down(2)
    wizard.move_right(2)
hints: Look at the `if` condition. When the left door is locked, the program tries to open it!
Swap the instructions inside the `if` and the `else`.
When the left door is locked, move to the right door instead.
intro: Oh no, {wizard}... I tried to write the program for this room, but I keep walking into the locked door. Can you see what I did wrong?
outro: Thank you! I put the right instructions in the wrong places. Now we are at the foot of the long stairs.
learned: Now you know how to read an `if` and its `else` and find which one does what.
